item.title: Checking into a hostel
item.context_text: You are on holiday. You arrive at a small hostel in the city centre. The receptionist is at the desk. Later, your friend Dilnoza comes to the hostel too.
item.objective_text: Check in, understand the receptionist, and tell your friend your room and the breakfast time.
item.target_grammar: present simple with be (I am in room 6. Breakfast is at 7:30.)
item.cultural_note: In a hostel you often share a room with other travellers. Say hello to them and keep the room quiet at night.
success_conditions: Understand your booking: nights and breakfast
Give your name and the number of nights at reception
Tell your friend your room number and the breakfast time

children.title: Read your booking
children.instructions: Read the booking email on your phone. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
BOOKING CONFIRMED
Hostel: Green House Hostel
Room: 4-bed room
Nights: 3 (Friday to Monday)
Breakfast: 7:30 to 10:00, in the kitchen
Check-in: from 2 pm

questions.prompt: How many nights is your booking?

questions.explanation: The booking says breakfast is "in the kitchen".

children.title: Talk to the receptionist
children.instructions: The receptionist says hello. Answer out loud. Say your name and how many nights you are staying.
children.prompt_text: Receptionist: Hello! Do you have a booking?
children.goal: Give your name and say how many nights you are staying.
children.model_answer: Yes, I do. My name is Malika Karimova. I am here for three nights.

children.title: Listen to the receptionist
children.instructions: Listen to the receptionist. Then answer the questions. You can listen again.
children.prompt_text: Thank you. Welcome! You are in room six, on the second floor. Sorry, the lift is broken today. The stairs are on the left. The Wi-Fi password is on your key card. Have a nice stay!

questions.explanation: The receptionist says "You are in room six".
The receptionist says "The Wi-Fi password is on your key card."

children.title: Text your friend
children.instructions: Your friend Dilnoza is coming to the hostel later. Write a message. Tell her your room number and the breakfast time.
children.prompt_text: Dilnoza: I'm at the bus station now. Where are you?
children.goal: Tell Dilnoza your room number and when breakfast is.
children.model_answer: Hi Dilnoza! I am in room 6, on the second floor. The lift is broken, so take the stairs. Breakfast is from 7:30 to 10 in the kitchen.
